biggest_catch: Campaigns are periodic, capped, and first-come-first-served — there is no standing per-quiz payout, Bitget publishes no fixed per-quiz figure, and Bitget does not serve US users (a recent official campaign's region list excluded the US).
catches: Bitget runs Learn2Earn as rotating campaigns, not an always-on per-module payout — a campaign must be currently open for there to be anything to earn.
Official terms: 'Rewards are limited, first come first served' and 'Rewards will be distributed to the winners' accounts within 7 working days after the end of the promotion.'

One official campaign was restricted to the UK, Canada, Australia, South Asia, the Philippines, Nigeria, and South Africa — the US is not served (the catalog's 'US availability varies' means US users are excluded).
Rewards are paid in project tokens (BGB and others) whose dollar value fluctuates — crypto is never fixed income.
Identity verification is required; duplicate IP/multi-account abuse is disqualified; points are redeemable only for coupons and gifts.

c1.evidence: Bitget is a real operating exchange (bitget.com); official Learn2Earn hub at bitget.com/launchhub/learn-to-earn and official support-center campaign articles.

c2.evidence: Official Bitget Support Center articles document the Learn2Earn program mechanics: read the introduction, answer all quiz questions correctly, rewards first-come-first-served, distributed within 7 working days after the promotion ends.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee to join the program or take quizzes.

c4.evidence: No fixed per-quiz official payout figure exists — the pay MECHANISM is verified (per-campaign token rewards, first-come-first-served), but payout_quote is null since Bitget publishes no standing amount.

eligibility: Bitget account with identity verification, in a supported region (campaigns publish region lists; the US is excluded). During a promotion, users get one quiz attempt per day until all answers are correct.
notes: Mechanism-only verify (R0404 pattern): Bitget's Learn2Earn program is real and currently documented on official bitget.com sources — the Learn2Earn hub (launchhub/learn-to-earn), the academy 'Learn Basics and Earn Free Tokens' page, and support-center campaign articles (Holdstation 10 BGB, SuiNS 15 NS, BWB 5 BGB, Shark Fin 100 BGB examples; a recent Launchpool Learn-to-Earn quiz offered a share of 20,000 BGB with a 1,000-user first-come cap and distribution within 10 working days). The campaigns are real but periodic; the app must direct users to check the Learn2Earn hub for a currently open campaign rather than presenting a guaranteed payout. No commits, no DB writes.

s1.note: Bitget account + identity verification; per-campaign region lists (US excluded); one quiz attempt per day during a promotion.

s2.note: First-come-first-served caps (e.g. first 1,000 users); rewards in tokens (volatile); distribution after the promotion ends (7-10 working days).

s3.note: Rewards distributed within 7-10 working days after the end of the promotion (per official terms).

s4.note: Official materials never promise a fixed per-quiz amount — must not show '$2-$10' as a standing figure.

s5.note: https://www.bitget.com/launchhub/learn-to-earn and official bitget.com support-center campaign articles.

s6.note: Steps concrete: register → verify → open the Learn2Earn hub → join an open campaign → read introduction → answer all quiz questions correctly → reward credited after the promotion ends.

s7.note: Official Bitget Learn2Earn hub and support-center articles read 2026-09-23.

steps: Create a Bitget account and complete identity verification (US residents cannot use Bitget).
Open the official Learn2Earn hub (bitget.com/launchhub/learn-to-earn) and check for a currently OPEN campaign — do not start unless one is live.
Read the campaign's project introduction carefully, then complete the Learn2Earn quiz with all answers correct (one attempt per day during the promotion).
Confirm you are within the participant cap and region list — rewards are first-come-first-served.
Receive the token reward in your Bitget account within 7-10 working days after the promotion ends.
timing: Rewards distributed to winners' accounts within 7-10 working days after the end of each promotion (per official campaign terms). Campaigns are periodic — the hub must be checked for a live one.
